literature.headline: Presented as technical amendments to cut compliance costs, the package makes substantive changes without a proper assessment of their impact, which could add legal uncertainty and create loopholes.

literature.title: The European Union needs more than the digital omnibus to make digital services competitive
literature.method: policy analysis of the digital and AI omnibus proposals
literature.headline: Consolidating data rules around the Data Act is sensible, but the omnibus introduces new inconsistencies, leaves the Data Act's shortcomings unaddressed and falls far short of transformative reform.
